text: Hello, I noticed {$58.00} and {$48.00} being taken out of my Wells Fargo bank on a monthly basis, since XX/XX/2023. I thought the withdrawals were going to my health insurance XXXX XXXX plan but when I called XXXX them they said it wasn't them. The XXXX was going to a fake XXXX loyalty plan and the {$48.00} was going to some life insurance, Called XXXX, that I didn't sign up for. When I Explained this to my financial institute Wells fargo, roughly a week ago, they did some research then refunded a portion of the money and then stated they can not refund any more money because they cant get anymore from the group that stole my money. THIS DOES NOT MAKE SENSE TO ME. I thought FDIC covers you if you are found to be a victim of fraud. They honored some of the money so it is obvious to me that I am right and some one took my money under their watch. Can you help me?
